KV cache behavior

` - copy diag-v2.png into /static/assets/batching/diag-v2.png and update path - run a replace for any stray /docs/runtime/batching#kv-cache -> /docs/runtime/batching#kv-cache (ensuring matches) maria: perfect — assign to sam for review when ready, please mention codeowners for runtime (owner: @samops) so it auto-assigns. toni: will do. ETA a PR in ~30m. testing preview locally and on netlify. deploy-bot: preview build started for branch docs/fix/batching-anchors-2026 — preview URL: https://deploy-preview-326-batching.netlify.app :construction: sam: :+1: i'll review once the preview is up. also can we add a tiny lint rule to flag broken internal anchors in the docs CI? low-priority but would help. maria: agree — file a follow-up ticket and we can triage for next docs-sprint. thanks toni! :raised_hands:
